events.label: Наука
entries: 1886 – Henri Moissan isolated elemental Fluorine for the first time.
2000 – The Human Genome Project announces the completion of a "rough draft" sequence.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1909 – The Science Museum in London comes into existence as an independent entity.
1977 – Elvis Presley holds what will prove to be his final concert at Market Square Arena in Indianapolis, Indiana.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1889 – Bangui is founded by Albert Dolisie and Alfred Uzac in what was then the upper reaches of the French Congo.
1952 – The Pan-Malayan Labour Party is founded in Malaya, as a union of statewide labour parties.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1948 – Shirley Jackson's short story "The Lottery" is published in The New Yorker magazine.
1997 – J. K. Rowling publishes the first of her Harry Potter novel series, Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone in United Kingdom.
